sc: Blue blubber jellyfish is a type of fish that can only be found at the Deep Sea Fishing Hub, which can be accessed by talking to Goomah in the Fishing Guild.

A mis-fortune from The Mighty Zoltan (7/.x: A mis-fortune from The Mighty Zoltan (7/17) is one of the 17 mis-fortunes granted by The Mighty Zoltan at the Spring Fayre.

sc: It could be obtained as part of the Combat Academy tutorial from the melee combat set.
Ancestor spirits was a tier three aura that could be bought from the Loyalty Programme Shop for 50,000 loyalty points.
The augmented crystal halberd is a tier 70 melee two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a crystal halberd.
The Augmented Dracolich chaps is created by using an augmentor on a Dracolich chaps.

The barrows-dyed augmented off-hand drygore mace is a level 90 Melee off-hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Off-hand drygore mace (Barrows), or by using barrows dye on an augmented off-hand drygore mace.
The augmented Seasinger's robe top is a level 85 Magic torso slot item created by using an augmentor on a Superior seasinger's robe top.
Avocado sauce was a random topping obtained with a plain wrap from the Squeal of Fortune between 5 May and 13 May 2013.

sc: Basic Solak-o'-lantern spoils are items rewarded from completing the Solak-o'-lantern encounter in the Maize Maze.
A bass certificate was an item from RuneScape Classic that was created by using five bass on Padik or Owen.
Beach Spade is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained alongside the Beach Bucket by converting a summer prize token.
It was originally available from the 2015 Summer Raffle.
It is a possible reward from opening an easy reward casket as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Heraldic armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be decorated by any players.
Black stone arrows are tier 92 arrows that are created by attaching black stone arrow tips to elder headless shafts at level 92 Fletching.
The arrowheads are obtained as drops from the Shadow Reef.
It can be obtained as a Treasure Trail reward or purchased from either another player or from the Grand Exchange.
It cannot be made using the Crafting skill.
Blue crabs are too high of a tiered item to be dropped by monsters, but they can appear on the starting table upon entering a dungeon.
Blue crab is one of the Dungeoneering fish that cannot be received as monster drop, the other is cave moray.
A botanist's amulet is made by enchanting a jade amulet with the Lvl-2 Enchant spell.

This includes the free dose bonuses given by wearing three pieces of the factory outfit and/or the Morytania legs 4 (for prayer renewals), as well as the double potion chance from a modified botanist's mask and/or portable well.
It is made by custom-fitting masterwork magic boots via the master Crafter in the clothesmaking area of the Crafting Guild.
It was made by combining a blue charm with 102 spirit shards and a Bronze bar.

Spirit gems, which are dropped by all monsters that drop a single charm and could be received from the Squeal of Fortune, functioned similarly to Runecrafting pouches and stored uncharged summoning pouches before an update.
The bryll robe bottom is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.

Bucket of water (Tutorial Island).x: Bucket of water is an item obtained on Tutorial Island. Like other objects which contain water, it can be combined with a pot of flour in order to make various doughs, including, specifically, bread, doing so would give a player an empty bucket, which can be refilled at a water source to re-obtain the bucket of water.

sc: The butterfly net (class 5) from the Stealing Creation minigame is made by using class 5 sacred clay on a creation kiln.
It is bought from Lanthus for 2 silver Castle wars tickets.
97 days (383 hours and 20 minutes) worth of Castle Wars play time to obtain this cape.
A cat mask is a cosmetic mask available from medium clue scrolls.
Chaotic Hurricane cosmetic ability scroll (untradeable) is a potential reward from Santa's Christmas Present.
The black version of the chic scarf is available from the Marketplace for 250 oddments.
The chimp ice enhancer is a reward enhancer that doubles the time a chimp ice is frozen by ice spells.
When obtained, it is automatically converted into 50 charges within Wythien's enhancer management interface, where the effect can be toggled on or off.
It is unlocked by redeeming a Christmas jumper token (Christmas tree), which can be won on Treasure Hunter during the Advent Calendar (2019) promotion.

Circus (Audience) Pants.x: The Circus (Audience) Pants are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Audience) outfit. They are unlocked alongside their item versions, the skirt and leggings.

sc: A compass piece is obtained by completing a section of the 2015 RuneScape Road Trip tasks.
They are obtained in the same order regardless of category completed.

Competitive Group Ironman helm 2.x: Competitive Group Ironman helm 2 is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Competitive Group Ironman armour 2.

sc: If making pouches in Taverley, then compost can be stored with the nearby tool leprechaun, and many pouches can be made quickly.
Constitution XP lamp is a possible reward from the Observatory Quest.

Courier trousers.x: Courier trousers is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Courier outfit.

tx: Crystal-flecked sandstone can be mined in two locations: one in Ithell district and another in Meilyr district (Edimmu resource dungeon).
sc: Crystal-flecked sandstone can be mined from crystal-flecked sandstone mines at level 81 Mining; this can be boosted.
It can be made into crystal glass by using a robust glass machine.
The dragonbone boots are created by using the Dragonbone upgrade kit on a pair of Dragon boots.

sc: An elite chest is an item dropped by The Ambassador after completing the Temple of Aminishi, Dragonkin Laboratory, and The Shadow Reef in consecutive order.
The chest can be searched for an assortment of drops from the three Elite Dungeons, destroying the chest in the process.
It is made by adding a jade to an exquisite mining urn (no gem).
It can be commonly found by excavating the blood altar excavation hotspots at the Moonrise Dig Site.
Farewell to Kili can be randomly obtained by excavating the Warforge weapon rack and makeshift pie oven excavation hotspots at the Warforge Dig Site.

Fatebound Weapon Bundle.x: The Fatebound Weapon Bundle is a cosmetic override pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 1050 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 945 RuneCoins for members.

w: Big event mystery box (Birth by Fire)
sc: During the Wintumber Warmer, this item could be obtained by skilling in the Lumbridge Crater, and it could be used by taking part in the fire dancing activity with Emmet.
It can be purchased from the shady ghost at the Ectofuntus for 1,000 ecto-tokens.
The Fishing trophy is awarded as a result of winning the fishing competition in the Fishing Contest quest.
It is possible to obtain multiple copies of this item using the Drop trick; by taking a trophy from Bonzo, dropping it, then taking a spare, and pick up the other trophy from the floor.
Fletcher's boots are a reward from the Stealing Creation minigame.
The item was originally created from 500 lightweight feathers when these were obtainable between 10 March 2016 to 14 March 2016 as an exclusive prize from Treasure Hunter.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
Glacor Adornment is a cosmetic override unlocked by consuming a Glacor's Adornment.

Golden warpriest of Zamorak helm.x: The golden warpriest of Zamorak helm is a hybrid head armour that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle (except the 2015 raffle) and is part of the golden warpriest of Zamorak armour set.

sc: It could be made by using a green marionette (torso) on the crate that held green marionette heads in Diango's Workshop.
The grim gem is an item given to the player by Death for the Soul Reaper.
It is found while searching trees near the zombie trails at level 15 Wilderness.
This hook can be obtained during A Void Dance when players are in the Black Knight antechamber.
This item cannot be obtained as the actual reward from the Sunday ceremonies.
A huge fallen star (Crafting) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Crafting skill.
2× the experience given by a huge XP lamp.
It is created by using a masterwork runic conduit on a runecrafting altar, taking 25 minutes (2,500 ticks).
The Invictum Outfit is an outfit that is obtained by spending 100% respect from participating in the Artisans' Workshop.

Ishhara.x: Ishhara is a companion pet that players can unlock by inspecting a corrupted egg, which may be found very rarely around Menaphos and Sophanem.

sc: A large fallen star (Fletching) is a rare and uncommon prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Fletching skill.
2× the experience given by a large XP lamp.
A large XP lamp (Thieving) is a rare prize from Treasure Hunter.
Maggoty pie shell is a quest item obtained from Nails Newton during certain phase of Let Them Eat Pie quest.
Mallory is a pet version of Araxxi that can be unlocked as a pet by inspecting an Araxyte egg, which is obtained as a drop from killing Araxxi.

Manticore Off-hand Sword.x: Manticore Off-hand Sword is an off-hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Manticore Melee Weapon Pack.

Master crafter hatchet.x: The master crafter hatchet is a main hand axe cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3,000 oddments on a rotational basis in the Marketplace alongside its off-hand variant by purchasing the master crafter weapons pack. It was originally a reward from the Master Crafting time-limited event. Players could earn it by handing in 18,500 master crafting patch

sc: Master knock-out was a tier 3 aura available as part of the Members Loyalty Programme and could be purchased from Xuan at Varrock square for 50,000 Loyalty points.
The knock-out auras did not work in PvP, or against bosses and they only worked for attacks made by the player-character.

It is made on a player-owned port Scrimshaw Crafter with 4 ancient bones, provided the memory-crushing scrimshaw scroll has been purchased from Boni (who requires you to have 80 Divination and have upgraded your Ports workshop, in order to buy the scroll) on Waiko for 5,000 chimes and 5 taijitu.

When activated, it gives the player a 15% chance to instantly convert memories as they are obtained from a wisp, granting Divination experience - this effect is the same as (and will additively stack with) the light creature passive and scroll effect.
The Morty Bunny appearance token is a token unlock item that can be randomly obtained by redeeming a Skill Pet Bunny appearance token or by opening a mystery egg.
Mycelial webbing is an item obtained by gathering produce from rare breeds of zygomite, such as Zanarian zygomite and Arcspore zygomite or Daemoncap zygomite, at the player-owned farm.

Necturion (Masterwork) Shield.x: The Necturion (Masterwork) Shield is a shield cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion (Masterwork) Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, it can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The Ocean's Mage Staff is a two-handed magic weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by progressing through the RunePass.
It can be bought from the rewards trader in Daemonheim for 7,500 dungeoneering tokens.
It can also be obtained by players who do not have the original rubber chicken.
If you drop or lose your off-hand rubber chicken, you must kill chickens and obtain it as a drop again.

One Special Beach Day Shoes.x: One Special Beach Day Shoes is a feet slot cosmetic override that is part of the One Special Beach Day Outfit.

sc: The oni orokami mask is an orokami mask that can be obtained from a fortunate orokami as a rare loot from either free-hand catching it or looting a fortunate orokami jar.

tx: Uncut onyx can be purchased from TzHaar-Hur-Lek's Ore and Gem Store in TzHaar City, as a reward from the Fight Kiln, mining ores to obtain a metamorphic geode, in an oyster in a player-owned house aquarium, rarely from a menaphite gift offering, by pickpocketing TzHaar-Hur traders in TzHaar City, or as a drop from difficult bosses such as Araxxi or TzKal-Zuk. 100 onyx dust can also be transmuted to form an uncut onyx.
sc: As there are only a limited number of ways to obtain an onyx gem, it is the second-rarest gem in RuneScape behind the hydrix, which requires an onyx to complete.
There are other, far cheaper and simpler ways to obtain onyx bolt tips, therefore this practice is not recommended due to the value of the gem.
It is made by the player using 3 High-quality bronze bars.

sc: It can be made by using a bucket of Ugthanki dung on a bronze longsword while standing in the Kharidian Desert.
The penguin staff is a Magic weapon only available through Elite Treasure Trails and T4 dice.

sc: It can be found in Edmond and Arlena's house in the north-west of East Ardougne.
The plain woodcutting urn (full) is an item made by filling a plain woodcutting urn while chopping trees.
Poison detection potion (foul meat) can be created by using an unheated poison detection potion (foul meat) on the range at the Kitchen in Fort Forinthry.

sc: A powered necromantic seal of the Faceless is an item created by crafting at least five miasma runes in one action while carrying an unpowered seal.
The primal spear can only be obtained by getting it as a drop from World-gorger Shukarhazh, who requires a Dungeoneering level of 107 to encounter and defeat.
The Quick-Fire Crossbow is a cosmetic override available from Solomon's General Store.
It can be caught from the shrimp swimming around, and can then be cooked to make boiled shrimp.
The really rotten potato is a joke item dropped by JMod clones.
They can be obtained from breeding, or checking an unchecked red dragon egg.
The eggs can be obtained from killing red dragons, with a drop rate of 1/2,000.

Refined anima core body of Zaros
u: Augmented refined anima core body of Zaros
sc: It can be made at level 80 Crafting by combining an anima core body of Zaros with 3 of each of the essences – Serenic, Sliskean, Zamorakian, and Zarosian – after the ability to craft refined anima core of Zaros armour has been unlocked by earning 750 Zarosian reputation.
The body degrades back to an unrefined body after 100,000 charges of combat, where it can be crafted again using more essences.
Remora's necklace is a reward from the Song from the Depths quest, given to the player by The Raptor after escaping from inside the Queen Black Dragon.
A Repentant ogre is a companion pet previously available from the Solomon's General Store.
It is exclusively available as a drop from the Queen Black Dragon.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 rune bars, requiring 1,200 progress to complete, granting a total of 480 Smithing experience.
It appears that it was going to be obtained at some point during the Crafting guild portion of the quest, from which one would obtain the oxidised iron dust.
Sailing token was a reward that could be won from Treasure Hunter during the Beyond The Arc promotion.

tx:
Sanfew serum is made by adding, in order, unicorn horn dust, clean snake weed and nail beast nails to an already made 3-dose super restore potion. Partially completed Sanfew serums are called mixture - step 1 and mixture - step 2, but are not drinkable in these forms.
Players therefore need to make sure that the unicorn horn dust is highlighted before clicking each of the vials to avoid accidentally drinking any of the super restores. Since the intermediate potions are not drinkable, the same danger does not exist once the unicorn horn dust has been added.
Herblore experience is given for each addition of one of the secondary ingredients in this potion.
▸ Production costs
Snake weed is untradeable, so its value is subjective and has not been included in the calculation.
sc: This potion can be made into a Sanfew serum flask by using at least six doses of it with a potion flask.
Skypouncer is a cosmetic override set that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
It could originally be unlocked through purchasing either a £20/$25 game card or new 3-month membership subscription between 21 March and 30 April 2013.
It can be traded in for various rewards in the Prifddinas Waterfall Fishing Shop or ground into harmony dust.
A small XP lamp (Defence) is a common prize from Treasure Hunter.
Springsheared wool is an item obtained by gathering produce from a springsheared ewe or ram grown in the medium pen size of the player-owned farm.
The starfire hauberk is an item that can be bought from the DXP Token Store, the Portable Trader or made by combining 10,000 starlight ore during the promotion period.
They are part of the Seasinger equipment set, and can be made on a workbench in your player-owned port workshop with 20 chi at level 90 Runecrafting.

Throughout the swamp in the Tree Gnome Stronghold
sc: A swamp toad is a small creature with removable legs found in various swamps.
Swamp toads can also be obtained from a toad egg sac harvested from reeds grown in a hops patch, requiring level 78 Farming.
Symbol of Devastation token is an unlock token that may be awarded from Santa's Christmas Presents starting in 2025.
A teak drawers flatpack can be made at a workbench (Steel framed bench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.

Tempest Lord Armour (static).x: The Tempest Lord Armour (static) is a cosmetic override set unlocked alongside the Tempest Lord Armour set. Unlike the non-static version of the set, this set does not display additional visual effects in combat.

sc: Players also may receive swamp tar and green salamanders from harvesting reeds, but they are not obtained by opening these; they are separate yields.
The TzHaar-Ket-Om (also known as the Obsidian maul) is one of the few mauls in RuneScape, excluding the ones found whilst dungeoneering.
Players can buy the TzHaar-Ket-Om at the weapons store in the TzHaar City for 75,000 Tokkul, and it can be obtained as a rare drop from TzHaar-Ket.
Unfermented wine of Zamorak is made by using grapes of Zamorak on a jug of water.
An utuku staff is an item that can only be obtained and used while in Daemonheim.
It is produced using the Fletching skill.

u: Augmented vestments of havoc robe top

sc: Wen Acolyte's Talisman is an off-hand magic weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 16 of the Path of the Creators event, while having access to premier rewards.

Wushanko shoes (red, female).x: The red wushanko shoes are part of the wushanko outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.
